security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://* https://*; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Approve / deny Argo agent actions from mobile
bundle.longDescription: Thin client over the Argo gateway. Renders pending approvals + decides via the inbox/push routes. Deep-links from push notifications (argo://approve/<token>).
